newsitem.title: USA: RCM Capital holds 10.46 pct Guidant stake.
newsitem.headline: RCM Capital holds 10.46 pct Guidant stake.

text.p: RCM Capital Management LLC, a large San Francisco-based asset management concern, holds a 10.46-percent stake in Guidant Corp, according to a 13G filing with the U.S. Securities & Exchange Commission.
The stake is likely passive, said medical device industry analysts. Guidant declined comment. RCM could not be reached.
The filing made Monday said RCM controls 7.5 million, or 10.46 percent, of Guidant's total outstanding shares.
Indianapolis-based Guidant makes medical devices. It was spun off from Eli Lilly & Co in 1994.

When shares in the company fell sharply in mid-October on disappointing third-quarter sales growth, trading volumes soared for two weeks. One analyst said a handful of institutions took the chance to buy Guidant shares in the mid-40s. The shares were unchanged late Tuesday at 51-1/2.
